parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, back, and top.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the overall shape and stability of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports other components like doors and shelves.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a front panel made of MDF, attached to the frame with hinges and equipped with a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space and protects the contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close the cabinet.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, typically made of solid wood for strength.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that provides foundational support.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: The lower shelf is a horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: The upper shelf is another horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for smaller or lighter items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but does not move during normal use.
